items.title: File Widerspruch against the Bescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Friday 20.11.2026, sent by post. Per § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X (current version), it is deemed bekannt gegeben (notified) on the fourth day after posting: 20.11. + 4 days = 24.11.2026 (Tuesday). That day is a regular weekday in NW (no weekend/holiday shift needed). The one-month Widerspruch period then starts the following day (§ 26 SGB X / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB): 25.11.2026, and ends one month later per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB on the day with the same number, i.e. 24.12.2026 (Thursday). 24.12. is not a statutory public holiday in NW (only 25./26.12. are), so no further shift applies. Final deadline: 24.12.2026.
